text: **Your question D, answered precisely:** each app runs `flatc` itself and checks the output in locally for the FlatBuffers wire-type decoders (`OpFeedSnapshot` et al.) — NMP does not ship a prebuilt bindings package for iOS, Android, or web on this front (no regen script exists anywhere in Chirp's repo for it, a real process gap worth closing as part of chirp#35). This is DIFFERENT from action-builders: iOS/Android's `ActionBuilders.generated.*` ARE regeneratable via the documented `cargo run -p nmp-codegen -- gen action-builders --platform swift/kotlin` command. Web is different again — its action builders come from the external `@nmp/runtime-web` npm package (not a local generated file at all), so web's action-builders migration is entirely gated on that package publishing, same as web's FlatBuffers-decode fix (both blocked on the NMP#2497 / rc.2 publish you flagged).
